'''Nillia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who worked as a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She found her job boring and she longed to leave Zarra.
